model_weights.note: weight of each published model in the mixture

warnings: Each bus is counted once: no second pack, no discounting, and buses age independently inside each published model.
A bus still in service is taken to have not yet reached the model's replacement line. Operators often run packs below it.
The two models are mixed 50/50 by assumption. The fleet's own survival is not used to reweight them (that would be calibration).
Some buses have no in-service date and are counted as new, which pushes their replacement later than it may be.
response.disclaimer: Prior mode: capacity curves come from published laboratory-fitted LFP cell models (NREL BLAST-Lite) and scenario inputs are assumptions. Nothing here has been validated on buses.
